Name: JP's Trinkets - Wear More Trinkets
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][b][color=#00ff00][size=6][i][u]Wear More Trinkets[/u][/i][/size][/color][/b][/font][/center]
[center][/center]

[font=Georgia][b][color=#ff00ff][size=5][i]Now I'm followed by a fairy who flies high (but in a different sense), a smelly, ugly frog, and a parrot who never shuts up. What a great team. [/i][/size][/color][/b][/font]

[color=#00ffff][size=5][font=Georgia][b][u]Other Trinket Mods:[/u][/b][/font][/size][/color]
[size=4][font=Georgia][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/games/stardewvalley/mods/46822]Wear More Trinkets[/url][/font][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47338][size=4][font=Georgia]Early Trinkets[/font][/size][/url]
[font=Georgia][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47338][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53033][size=4]The Helpers[/size][/url][/font]

[font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Have you ever dreamed of equipping all your trinkets at once? Me neither, I just made the mod and that was it. [/i][/b][/size][/font]

[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]This mod allows you to equip between 2 and 40 trinkets at the same time.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][color=#ffff00]Access the new Trinket Inventory once you unlock Combat Mastery, or right from the start of the game with this [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47338]MOD[/url][/color]; the Trinket inventory tab will replace the old Trinket slot.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][b][size=4]In theory, all effects apply at the same time, at least with the in-game trinkets; with those added by mods, it depends.[/size][/b][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][b][size=4][color=#00ff00]The mod works on both PC and mobile, although the mobile version may have some minor issues (I did my best to fix them).[/color][/size][/b][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][b][color=#00ff00][size=5]Compatible with ‘Wear More Rings’ mod or Similar.[/size][/color][/b][/font][/*]
[/list]

[font=Georgia][b][i][color=#00ff00][size=5]That's it, GMCM is very necessary in this mod in order to configure the mod according to your preferences. You will find detailed information in each option. [/size][/color][/i]


[i][u][color=#ffff00][size=5]Translations[/size][/color][/u][/i]
[color=#ffffff][size=4]You are free to translate the mod; [/size][/color][size=4][color=#ff0000]you don't need to ask my permission.[/color]
[color=#ffffff]You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods.[/color]
[color=#ffffff]If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there. [/color][/size][/b][/font]
